nodes.definition: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, neural networks, foundation models, and autonomous intelligent systems.
nodes.name: AI and ML

nodes.definition: Practical guidance and firsthand accounts about job searching, launching or running an independent business or creative career, and non-traditional paths into a profession.
include: job search or hiring practice advice for an individual (e.g., avoiding mass-application pitfalls)
a solopreneur's daily routine of shipping or validating independent products
a person's self-taught or non-traditional path into a technical career
financial or business pacing advice for a creative professional or artist
a founder or entrepreneur interview covering how to start a startup
exclude: AI industry-wide financial or market trend without a personal career or business frame -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
a technical step-by-step tutorial aimed at skill-building rather than career/business strategy -> AI and ML / Education
nodes.name: Career and Entrepreneurship

nodes.definition: Clips and commentary reporting or discussing real-world breaking incidents, crimes, armed conflicts, and political or social debates shared via social media and news broadcasts.
include: breaking reports naming a specific crime, riot, or armed-conflict incident
raw police/military radio or scanner audio captured during an unfolding event
political or cultural opinion segments from talk shows or panels
exclude: discussion of an AI/tech product or capability -> AI and ML
an AI agent or model demonstrated performing a task -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
AI company business, market, or competitive commentary -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
nodes.name: News and Current Events

nodes.definition: Space exploration, astronautics, astrophysics, orbital mechanics, planetary science, and empirical scientific inquiry.
nodes.name: Space and Science

nodes.definition: AI agent products and features that autonomously execute multi-step, real-world tasks and business workflows on a user's or company's behalf.
include: an agent autonomously completes a multi-step real-world task (booking, shopping, ordering) without step-by-step direction
an AI agent running an end-to-end business function (sales, underwriting, coaching, ad analysis) without human operators
a bot completing a concrete office or admin task on request (sending documents, messages)
an installed or locally-run AI agent whose autonomy or operating constraints are described
exclude: coding-specific agent harnesses, IDE tools, or SDKs for software engineers -> AI and ML / Developer Tools
the demoed output is a finished creative/video artifact rather than a task performed -> AI and ML / AI Generative Media
company financial, competitive, or market commentary without a task demo -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
nodes.name: AI Agents and Automation

nodes.definition: AI systems, models, and pipelines that generate video, animation, or film content from prompts, and the finished creative outputs they produce.
include: prompt-driven generation of video, animation, or images explicitly described as AI-made
a named foundation model used specifically to produce a video, image, or animation output
an AI-generated film or video entered in or winning an AI-specific award or competition
an AI-generated video praised or showcased for its entertainment or creative value
exclude: model architecture, scaling, or benchmark evaluation without a shown creative output -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent product performing a real-world task rather than generating creative media -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
company financial, market, or competitive commentary about an AI company -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
nodes.name: AI Generative Media

nodes.definition: Business, financial, competitive, and policy developments in the AI industry, including company revenue, mergers and acquisitions, market rivalry, and government actions affecting AI labs.
include: AI company revenue, ARR, or financial performance figures
competitive rivalry or market-position claims between named AI labs or executives
AI company mergers, acquisitions, or major infrastructure and business deals
government policy or restrictions affecting a specific AI company's access to technology or markets
exclude: technical model architecture, scaling, or capability benchmarks -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent or product demonstrating a real-world task rather than company financials or competition -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
a finished AI-generated creative artifact shown as the output -> AI and ML / AI Generative Media
nodes.name: AI Industry and Business

nodes.definition: Software engineering tooling, agent harnesses, IDE extensions, coding assistants, SDKs, and developer-focused workflows.
exclude: pure theoretical ML papers without tools
nodes.name: Developer Tools

nodes.definition: Lectures, pedagogical explanations, conceptual deep dives, tutorials, and fundamental principles of machine learning.
nodes.name: Education

nodes.definition: Architectures, capability evaluations, multimodal systems, scaling behavior, and releases of frontier foundation models.
